[1700](#1700)
[1701](#1701)fn collect_reachable(
[1702](#1702)    store: &Store,
[1703](#1703)    commit_id: &str,
[1704](#1704)    seen_commits: &mut std::collections::HashSet<String>,
[1705](#1705)    reachable: &mut std::collections::HashSet<String>,
[1706](#1706)) -> Result<()> {
[1707](#1707)    if !seen_commits.insert(commit_id.to_string()) {
[1708](#1708)        return Ok(());
[1709](#1709)    }
[1710](#1710)
[1711](#1711)    reachable.insert(commit_id.to_string());
[1712](#1712)
[1713](#1713)    let commit = match load_commit(store, commit_id) {
[1714](#1714)        Ok(c) => c,
[1715](#1715)        Err(_) => return Ok(()),
[1716](#1716)    };
[1717](#1717)
[1718](#1718)    for manifest_id in &commit.manifests {
[1719](#1719)        reachable.insert(manifest_id.clone());
[1720](#1720)
[1721](#1721)        if let Ok(data) = store.get_chunk(manifest_id) {
[1722](#1722)            if let Ok(manifest) = metadata::deserialize::<FileManifest>(&data) {
[1723](#1723)                for chunk_id in &manifest.chunks {
[1724](#1724)                    reachable.insert(chunk_id.clone());
[1725](#1725)                }
[1726](#1726)            }
[1727](#1727)        }
[1728](#1728)    }
[1729](#1729)
[1730](#1730)    for parent_id in &commit.parents {
[1731](#1731)        collect_reachable(store, parent_id, seen_commits, reachable)?;
[1732](#1732)    }
[1733](#1733)
[1734](#1734)    Ok(())
[1735](#1735)}
[1736](#1736)
[1737](#1737)pub fn prune(path: &Path, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[1738](#1738)    let _guard = OP_QUEUES
[1739](#1739)        .get_or_create(&path.to_path_buf())
[1740](#1740)        .acquire(ops::OpKind::Write, "prune".to_string());
[1741](#1741)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[1742](#1742)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[1743](#1743)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[1744](#1744)    }
[1745](#1745)
[1746](#1746)    let config = load_config(&shard_dir)?;
[1747](#1747)    let fmt = MetadataFormat::from_config(&config);
[1748](#1748)
[1749](#1749)    let store = Store::open(&shard_dir)?;
[1750](#1750)    let mut reachable: std::collections::HashSet<String> = std::collections::HashSet::new();
[1751](#1751)
[1752](#1752)    let (_, head_commit) = branch::resolve_head(&shard_dir)?;
[1754](#1754)    if let Some(ref head) = head_commit {
[1755](#1755)        collect_reachable(
[1756](#1756)            &store,
[1757](#1757)            head,
[1758](#1758)            &mut std::collections::HashSet::new(),
[1759](#1759)            &mut reachable,
[1760](#1760)        )?;
[1761](#1761)    }
[1762](#1762)
[1763](#1763)    if let Ok(branches) = branch::list_branches(&shard_dir) {
[1765](#1765)        for (_, commit_id) in branches.1 {
[1766](#1766)            collect_reachable(
[1767](#1767)                &store,
[1768](#1768)                &commit_id,
[1769](#1769)                &mut std::collections::HashSet::new(),
[1770](#1770)                &mut reachable,
[1771](#1771)            )?;
[1772](#1772)        }
[1773](#1773)    }
[1774](#1774)
[1775](#1775)    let tags = load_tags(&shard_dir)?;
[1777](#1777)    for commit_id in tags.values() {
[1778](#1778)        collect_reachable(
[1779](#1779)            &store,
[1780](#1780)            commit_id,
[1781](#1781)            &mut std::collections::HashSet::new(),
[1782](#1782)            &mut reachable,
[1783](#1783)        )?;
[1784](#1784)    }
[1785](#1785)
[1786](#1786)    let index = Index::load(&shard_dir.join("index"), &fmt)?;
[1788](#1788)    for manifest in index.files.values() {
[1789](#1789)        let json = metadata::serialize(manifest, &fmt);
[1790](#1790)        let hash = blake3::hash(&json);
[1791](#1791)        let hash_hex = hash.to_hex().to_string();
[1792](#1792)        reachable.insert(hash_hex);
[1793](#1793)        for chunk_hash in &manifest.chunks {
[1794](#1794)            reachable.insert(chunk_hash.clone());
[1795](#1795)        }
[1796](#1796)    }
[1797](#1797)
[1798](#1798)    let all_chunks = store.iter_chunks()?;
[1800](#1800)    let mut pruned = 0u64;
[1801](#1801)    let mut kept = 0u64;
[1802](#1802)    for (hash_hex, full_path) in &all_chunks {
[1803](#1803)        if !reachable.contains(hash_hex) {
[1804](#1804)            store.delete_chunk(hash_hex, Some(full_path))?;
[1805](#1805)            pruned += 1;
[1806](#1806)        } else {
[1807](#1807)            kept += 1;
[1808](#1808)        }
[1809](#1809)    }
[1810](#1810)
[1811](#1811)    if json {
[1812](#1812)        info!(
[1813](#1813)            "{}",
[1814](#1814)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
[1815](#1815)                "pruned": pruned,
[1816](#1816)                "remaining": kept,
[1817](#1817)            }))?
[1818](#1818)        );
[1819](#1819)    } else {
[1820](#1820)        info!("Pruned {} objects. {} objects remain.", pruned, kept);
[1821](#1821)    }
[1822](#1822)    Ok(())
[1823](#1823)}
[1824](#1824)
[1825](#1825)pub fn peer_add(path: &Path, multiaddr: &str, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[1826](#1826)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[1827](#1827)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[1828](#1828)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[1829](#1829)    }
[1830](#1830)
[1831](#1831)    if multiaddr.is_empty() || multiaddr.parse::<shard_net::libp2p::Multiaddr>().is_err() {
[1833](#1833)        anyhow::bail!("invalid multiaddr '{}' (must be a valid libp2p multiaddr, e.g. /ip4/1.2.3.4/tcp/5678/p2p/...)", multiaddr);
[1834](#1834)    }
[1835](#1835)
[1836](#1836)    let peers_path = shard_dir.join("peers.json");
[1837](#1837)    let mut peers: Vec<String> = if peers_path.exists() {
[1838](#1838)        let data = fs::read(&peers_path)?;
[1839](#1839)        serde_json::from_slice(&data)?
[1840](#1840)    } else {
[1841](#1841)        Vec::new()
[1842](#1842)    };
[1843](#1843)
[1844](#1844)    let added = if !peers.contains(&multiaddr.to_string()) {
[1845](#1845)        peers.push(multiaddr.to_string());
[1846](#1846)        let data = serde_json::to_vec(&peers)?;
[1847](#1847)        fs::write(peers_path, data)?;
[1848](#1848)        true
[1849](#1849)    } else {
[1850](#1850)        false
[1851](#1851)    };
[1852](#1852)
[1853](#1853)    if json {
[1854](#1854)        info!(
[1855](#1855)            "{}",
[1856](#1856)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
[1857](#1857)                "multiaddr": multiaddr,
[1858](#1858)                "added": added,
[1859](#1859)            }))?
[1860](#1860)        );
[1861](#1861)    } else if added {
[1862](#1862)        info!("Added peer: {}", multiaddr);
[1863](#1863)    } else {
[1864](#1864)        info!("Peer already exists: {}", multiaddr);
[1865](#1865)    }
[1866](#1866)
[1867](#1867)    Ok(())
[1868](#1868)}
[1869](#1869)
[1870](#1870)fn load_peers(shard_dir: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>> {

[1872](#1872)    if peers_path.exists() {
[1873](#1873)        let data = fs::read(peers_path)?;
[1874](#1874)        Ok(serde_json::from_slice(&data)?)
[1875](#1875)    } else {
[1876](#1876)        Ok(Vec::new())
[1877](#1877)    }

[1879](#1879)
[1880](#1880)fn authorized_keys_path(shard_dir: &Path) -> std::path::PathBuf {
[1881](#1881)    shard_dir.join("authorized_keys")
[1882](#1882)}
[1883](#1883)
[1884](#1884)struct AuthorizedKeyEntry {
[1886](#1886)    key: ed25519_dalek::VerifyingKey,
[1887](#1887)    comment: String,
[1888](#1888)}
[1889](#1889)
[1890](#1890)fn parse_authorized_key_line(line: &str) -> Option<AuthorizedKeyEntry> {
[1891](#1891)    let line = line.trim();
[1892](#1892)    if line.is_empty() || line.starts_with('#') {
[1893](#1893)        return None;
[1894](#1894)    }
[1895](#1895)    let parts: Vec<&str> = line.splitn(2, char::is_whitespace).collect();
[1897](#1897)    let hex_key = parts[0].trim();
[1898](#1898)    let comment = parts.get(1).unwrap_or(&"").trim().to_string();
[1899](#1899)    let bytes = hex::decode(hex_key).ok()?;
[1900](#1900)    let arr: [u8; 32] = bytes.try_into().ok()?;
[1901](#1901)    let key = ed25519_dalek::VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&arr).ok()?;
[1902](#1902)    Some(AuthorizedKeyEntry { key, comment })
[1903](#1903)}
[1904](#1904)
[1905](#1905)fn load_authorized_keys(shard_dir: &Path) -> Result<Vec<ed25519_dalek::VerifyingKey>> {
[1906](#1906)    let path = authorized_keys_path(shard_dir);
[1907](#1907)    if !path.exists() {
[1908](#1908)        return Ok(Vec::new());
[1909](#1909)    }
[1910](#1910)    let content = fs::read_to_string(&path)?;
[1911](#1911)    let mut keys = Vec::new();
[1912](#1912)    for line in content.lines() {
[1913](#1913)        if let Some(entry) = parse_authorized_key_line(line) {
[1914](#1914)            keys.push(entry.key);
[1915](#1915)        }
[1916](#1916)    }
[1917](#1917)    Ok(keys)
[1918](#1918)}
[1919](#1919)
[1920](#1920)pub fn add_authorized_key(shard_dir: &Path, public_key_hex: &str) -> Result<()> {
[1921](#1921)    let bytes = hex::decode(public_key_hex)?;
[1923](#1923)    let arr: [u8; 32] = bytes
[1924](#1924)        .as_slice()
[1925](#1925)        .try_into()
[1926](#1926)        .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("Public key must be 32 bytes (64 hex chars)"))?;
[1927](#1927)    let _pk = ed25519_dalek::VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&arr)?;
[1928](#1928)
[1929](#1929)    let path = authorized_keys_path(shard_dir);
[1930](#1930)    let mut content = if path.exists() {
[1931](#1931)        fs::read_to_string(&path)?
[1932](#1932)    } else {
[1933](#1933)        String::new()
[1934](#1934)    };
[1935](#1935)    if content.lines().any(|l| {
[1937](#1937)        if let Some(entry) = parse_authorized_key_line(l) {
[1938](#1938)            entry.key.to_bytes().to_vec() == arr.to_vec()
[1939](#1939)        } else {
[1940](#1940)            false
[1941](#1941)        }
[1942](#1942)    }) {
[1943](#1943)        info!("Key already authorized");
[1944](#1944)        return Ok(());
[1945](#1945)    }
[1946](#1946)    content.push_str(public_key_hex);
[1947](#1947)    content.push('\n');
[1948](#1948)    fs::write(&path, content)?;
[1949](#1949)    info!("Authorized key added");
[1950](#1950)    Ok(())
[1951](#1951)}
[1952](#1952)
[1953](#1953)pub fn remove_authorized_key(shard_dir: &Path, public_key_hex: &str) -> Result<()> {
[1954](#1954)    let path = authorized_keys_path(shard_dir);
[1955](#1955)    if !path.exists() {
[1956](#1956)        anyhow::bail!("authorized_keys file does not exist");
[1957](#1957)    }
[1958](#1958)    let content = fs::read_to_string(&path)?;
[1959](#1959)    let new_content: Vec<&str> = content
[1960](#1960)        .lines()
[1961](#1961)        .filter(|l| {
[1962](#1962)            if let Some(entry) = parse_authorized_key_line(l) {
[1963](#1963)                hex::encode(entry.key.to_bytes()) != public_key_hex
[1964](#1964)            } else {
[1965](#1965)                true
[1966](#1966)            }
[1967](#1967)        })
[1968](#1968)        .collect();
[1969](#1969)    if new_content.len() == content.lines().count() {
[1970](#1970)        anyhow::bail!("Key not found in authorized_keys");
[1971](#1971)    }
[1972](#1972)    let has_keys = new_content
[1973](#1973)        .iter()
[1974](#1974)        .any(|l| parse_authorized_key_line(l).is_some());
[1975](#1975)    if has_keys {
[1976](#1976)        fs::write(&path, new_content.join("\n") + "\n")?;
[1977](#1977)    } else {
[1978](#1978)        fs::remove_file(&path)?;
[1979](#1979)    }
[1980](#1980)    info!("Authorized key removed");
[1981](#1981)    Ok(())
[1982](#1982)}

[1984](#1984)pub fn list_authorized_keys(shard_dir: &Path, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[1985](#1985)    let path = authorized_keys_path(shard_dir);
[1986](#1986)    if !path.exists() {
[1987](#1987)        if json {
[1988](#1988)            info!(
[1989](#1989)                "{}",
[1990](#1990)                serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({"keys": []}))?
[1991](#1991)            );
[1992](#1992)        } else {
[1993](#1993)            println!("No authorized keys.");
[1994](#1994)        }
[1995](#1995)        return Ok(());
[1996](#1996)    }
[1997](#1997)    let content = fs::read_to_string(&path)?;
[1998](#1998)    let mut entries = Vec::new();
[1999](#1999)    for line in content.lines() {
[2000](#2000)        if let Some(entry) = parse_authorized_key_line(line) {
[2001](#2001)            entries.push(serde_json::json!({
[2002](#2002)                "key": hex::encode(entry.key.to_bytes()),
[2003](#2003)                "comment": entry.comment,
[2004](#2004)            }));
[2005](#2005)        }
[2006](#2006)    }
[2007](#2007)    if entries.is_empty() {
[2008](#2008)        if json {
[2009](#2009)            info!(
[2010](#2010)                "{}",
[2011](#2011)                serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({"keys": []}))?
[2012](#2012)            );
[2013](#2013)        } else {
[2014](#2014)            println!("No authorized keys.");
[2015](#2015)        }
[2016](#2016)        return Ok(());
[2017](#2017)    }
[2018](#2018)    if json {
[2019](#2019)        info!(
[2020](#2020)            "{}",
[2021](#2021)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({"keys": entries}))?
[2022](#2022)        );
[2023](#2023)    } else {
[2024](#2024)        for e in &entries {
[2025](#2025)            let comment = e["comment"].as_str().unwrap_or("");
[2026](#2026)            if comment.is_empty() {
[2027](#2027)                println!("  {}", e["key"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
[2028](#2028)            } else {
[2029](#2029)                println!("  {}  {}", e["key"].as_str().unwrap_or(""), comment);
[2030](#2030)            }
[2031](#2031)        }
[2032](#2032)    }
[2033](#2033)    Ok(())
[2034](#2034)}

[2036](#2036)pub fn backup(path: &Path, output: &Path, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[2037](#2037)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[2038](#2038)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[2039](#2039)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[2040](#2040)    }
[2041](#2041)    let file = fs::File::create(output)?;
[2042](#2042)    let encoder = flate2::write::GzEncoder::new(file, flate2::Compression::default());
[2043](#2043)    let mut archive = tar::Builder::new(encoder);
[2044](#2044)    archive.append_dir_all(".shard", &shard_dir)?;
[2045](#2045)    archive.finish()?;
[2046](#2046)    if json {
[2047](#2047)        info!(
[2048](#2048)            "{}",
[2049](#2049)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
[2050](#2050)                "path": output.to_string_lossy(),
[2051](#2051)            }))?
[2052](#2052)        );
[2053](#2053)    } else {
[2054](#2054)        info!("Backup created: {}", output.display());
[2055](#2055)    }
[2056](#2056)    Ok(())

[2059](#2059)pub fn export(path: &Path, commit_id: &str, output_dir: &Path, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[2060](#2060)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[2061](#2061)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[2062](#2062)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[2063](#2063)    }
[2064](#2064)    let store = Store::open(&shard_dir)?;
[2065](#2065)    let cipher = maybe_load_cipher(&shard_dir)?;
[2066](#2066)    let commit = load_commit(&store, commit_id)?;
[2067](#2067)    let mut files = Vec::new();
[2068](#2068)    for manifest_id in &commit.manifests {
[2069](#2069)        let data = store.get_chunk(manifest_id)?;
[2070](#2070)        let manifest: FileManifest = metadata::deserialize(&data)?;
[2071](#2071)        let compression = manifest.compression.parse::<Compression>()?;
[2072](#2072)        if !json {
[2073](#2073)            info!("Exporting file: {}", manifest.name);
[2074](#2074)        }
[2075](#2075)        let mut file_data = Vec::new();
[2076](#2076)        for chunk_id in &manifest.chunks {
[2077](#2077)            let chunk_data = store.get_chunk(chunk_id)?;
[2078](#2078)            let decrypted = match &cipher {
[2079](#2079)                Some(c) => c.decrypt(&chunk_data)?,
[2080](#2080)                None => chunk_data,
[2081](#2081)            };
[2082](#2082)            let decompressed = compression.decompress(&decrypted)?;
[2083](#2083)            file_data.extend_from_slice(&decompressed);
[2084](#2084)        }
[2085](#2085)        let out_path = output_dir.join(&manifest.name);
[2086](#2086)        if let Some(parent) = out_path.parent() {
[2087](#2087)            fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
[2088](#2088)        }
[2089](#2089)        fs::write(&out_path, file_data)?;
[2090](#2090)        if !json {
[2091](#2091)            info!("  -> {}", out_path.display());
[2092](#2092)        }
[2093](#2093)        files.push(manifest.name);
[2094](#2094)    }
[2095](#2095)    if json {
[2096](#2096)        info!(
[2097](#2097)            "{}",
[2098](#2098)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
[2099](#2099)                "commit_id": commit_id,
[2100](#2100)                "files": files,
[2101](#2101)                "output_dir": output_dir.to_string_lossy(),
[2102](#2102)            }))?
[2103](#2103)        );
[2104](#2104)    } else {
[2105](#2105)        info!("Export complete.");
[2106](#2106)    }
[2107](#2107)    Ok(())
[2108](#2108)}
[2109](#2109)
[2110](#2110)pub fn import(
[2111](#2111)    path: &Path,
[2112](#2112)    source_dir: &Path,
[2113](#2113)    message: &str,
[2114](#2114)    author: &str,
[2115](#2115)    json: bool,
[2116](#2116)) -> Result<()> {
[2117](#2117)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[2118](#2118)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[2119](#2119)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[2120](#2120)    }
[2121](#2121)    let config = load_config(&shard_dir)?;
[2123](#2123)    let compression: Compression = config
[2124](#2124)        .get("compression")
[2125](#2125)        .map(|s| s.as_str())
[2126](#2126)        .unwrap_or("zstd")
[2127](#2127)        .parse()?;
[2128](#2128)    let chunker_mode = chunker::ChunkerMode::from_config(&config);
[2129](#2129)    let fmt = MetadataFormat::from_config(&config);
[2130](#2130)    let store = Store::open(&shard_dir)?;
[2131](#2131)    let cipher = maybe_load_cipher(&shard_dir)?;
[2132](#2132)    let mut index = Index::load(&shard_dir.join("index"), &fmt)?;
[2133](#2133)    if !source_dir.is_dir() {
[2134](#2134)        anyhow::bail!("Source must be a directory");
[2135](#2135)    }
[2136](#2136)    let include_hidden = config
[2137](#2137)        .get("hidden_files_enabled")
[2138](#2138)        .map(|s| s.as_str() == "true")
[2139](#2139)        .unwrap_or(false);
[2140](#2140)    let mut builder = ignore::WalkBuilder::new(source_dir);
[2141](#2141)    builder.hidden(!include_hidden);
[2142](#2142)    for entry in builder.build() {
[2143](#2143)        let entry = entry.map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("{}", e))?;
[2144](#2144)        if entry.file_type().is_some_and(|ft| ft.is_file()) {
[2145](#2145)            add_file(
[2146](#2146)                path,
[2147](#2147)                entry.path(),
[2148](#2148)                &store,
[2149](#2149)                &mut index,
[2150](#2150)                &compression,
[2151](#2151)                &chunker_mode,
[2152](#2152)                cipher.as_ref(),
[2153](#2153)                json,
[2154](#2154)            )?;
[2155](#2155)        }
[2156](#2156)    }
[2157](#2157)    index.save(&shard_dir.join("index"), &fmt)?;
[2158](#2158)    if !index.files.is_empty() {
[2160](#2160)        commit(path, message, author, json)?;
[2161](#2161)    } else if json {
[2162](#2162)        info!(
[2163](#2163)            "{}",
[2164](#2164)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({"status": "no files found"}))?
[2165](#2165)        );
[2166](#2166)    } else {
[2167](#2167)        info!("No files found to import.");
[2168](#2168)    }
[2169](#2169)    Ok(())
[2170](#2170)}
[2171](#2171)
[2172](#2172)pub fn restore(path: &Path, backup_file: &Path, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[2173](#2173)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[2174](#2174)    if shard_dir.exists() {
[2175](#2175)        anyhow::bail!(
[2176](#2176)            "Repository already exists — remove .shard first or use a different directory"
[2177](#2177)        );
[2178](#2178)    }
[2179](#2179)    let file = fs::File::open(backup_file)?;
[2180](#2180)    let decoder = flate2::read::GzDecoder::new(file);
[2181](#2181)    let mut archive = tar::Archive::new(decoder);
[2182](#2182)    archive.unpack(path)?;
[2183](#2183)    if !path.join(".shard").exists() {
[2185](#2185)        anyhow::bail!("Backup does not contain a valid .shard directory");
[2186](#2186)    }
[2187](#2187)    if json {
[2188](#2188)        info!(
[2189](#2189)            "{}",
[2190](#2190)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
[2191](#2191)                "backup": backup_file.to_string_lossy(),
[2192](#2192)            }))?
[2193](#2193)        );
[2194](#2194)    } else {
[2195](#2195)        info!("Restored from {}", backup_file.display());
[2196](#2196)    }
[2197](#2197)    Ok(())
[2198](#2198)}
[2199](#2199)
[2200](#2200)struct RepoProvider {
[2201](#2201)    store: Store,
[2202](#2202)    shard_dir: std::path::PathBuf,
[2203](#2203)}
[2204](#2204)
[2205](#2205)impl shard_net::p2p::ShardContentProvider for RepoProvider {
[2206](#2206)    fn auth_required(&self) -> bool {
[2207](#2207)        self.shard_dir.join("authorized_keys").exists()
[2208](#2208)    }
[2209](#2209)    fn authenticate(&self, _peer_id: &shard_net::libp2p::PeerId, public_key: &[u8]) -> bool {
[2210](#2210)        let auth_path = self.shard_dir.join("authorized_keys");
[2211](#2211)        if !auth_path.exists() {
[2212](#2212)            return true; }
[2214](#2214)        let content = match std::fs::read_to_string(&auth_path) {
[2215](#2215)            Ok(c) => c,
[2216](#2216)            Err(_) => return false,
[2217](#2217)        };
[2218](#2218)        content.lines().any(|line| {
[2219](#2219)            let line = line.trim();
[2220](#2220)            !line.is_empty()
[2221](#2221)                && !line.starts_with('#')
[2222](#2222)                && hex::decode(line)
[2223](#2223)                    .map(|bytes| bytes.as_slice() == public_key)
[2224](#2224)                    .unwrap_or(false)
[2225](#2225)        })
[2226](#2226)    }
[2227](#2227)    fn get_manifest(&self, id: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
[2228](#2228)        self.store.get_chunk(id).ok()
[2229](#2229)    }
[2230](#2230)    fn get_chunk(&self, id: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
[2231](#2231)        self.store.get_chunk(id).ok()
[2232](#2232)    }
[2233](#2233)    fn put_chunk(&mut self, id: &str, data: &[u8]) -> bool {
[2234](#2234)        let hash = blake3::hash(data);
[2235](#2235)        let hex = hash.to_hex().to_string();
[2236](#2236)        if hex != id {
[2237](#2237)            return false;
[2238](#2238)        }
[2239](#2239)        self.store
[2240](#2240)            .put_chunk(&crate::chunker::Chunk {
[2241](#2241)                hash,
[2242](#2242)                data: data.to_vec(),
[2243](#2243)                offset: 0,
[2244](#2244)            })
[2245](#2245)            .is_ok()
[2246](#2246)    }
[2247](#2247)    fn verify_auth(&self, public_key: &[u8], nonce: &[u8], signature: &[u8]) -> bool {
[2248](#2248)        use ed25519_dalek::Verifier;
[2249](#2249)        let pk_bytes: [u8; 32] = match public_key.try_into() {
[2250](#2250)            Ok(b) => b,
[2251](#2251)            Err(_) => return false,
[2252](#2252)        };
[2253](#2253)        let pk = match ed25519_dalek::VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&pk_bytes) {
[2254](#2254)            Ok(k) => k,
[2255](#2255)            Err(_) => return false,
[2256](#2256)        };
[2257](#2257)        let sig_bytes: [u8; 64] = match signature.try_into() {
[2258](#2258)            Ok(b) => b,
[2259](#2259)            Err(_) => return false,
[2260](#2260)        };
[2261](#2261)        let sig = ed25519_dalek::Signature::from_bytes(&sig_bytes);
[2262](#2262)        if pk.verify(nonce, &sig).is_err() {
[2263](#2263)            return false;
[2264](#2264)        }
[2265](#2265)        let auth_path = self.shard_dir.join("authorized_keys");
[2269](#2269)        if auth_path.exists() {
[2270](#2270)            if let Ok(keys) = load_authorized_keys(&self.shard_dir) {
[2271](#2271)                return keys.contains(&pk);
[2272](#2272)            }
[2273](#2273)            return false;
[2274](#2274)        }
[2275](#2275)        true
[2276](#2276)    }
[2277](#2277)    fn repo_public_key(&self) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
[2278](#2278)        let keys = load_keypair(&self.shard_dir).ok()?;
[2279](#2279)        Some(keys.verifying_key.to_bytes().to_vec())
[2280](#2280)    }
[2281](#2281)}
[2282](#2282)
[2283](#2283)fn commit_stats(shard_dir: &Path, commit_id: &str) -> Result<(u64, u64)> {
[2285](#2285)    let store = Store::open(shard_dir)?;
[2286](#2286)    let commit = load_commit(&store, commit_id)?;
[2287](#2287)    let mut file_count = 0u64;
[2288](#2288)    let mut total_size = 0u64;
[2289](#2289)    for mid in &commit.manifests {
[2290](#2290)        if let Ok(data) = store.get_chunk(mid) {
[2291](#2291)            if let Ok(m) = metadata::deserialize::<FileManifest>(&data) {
[2292](#2292)                file_count += 1;
[2293](#2293)                total_size += m.size;
[2294](#2294)            }
[2295](#2295)        }
[2296](#2296)    }
[2297](#2297)    Ok((file_count, total_size))
[2298](#2298)}
[2299](#2299)
[2300](#2300)pub async fn share(path: &Path, listen_addr: &str, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[2301](#2301)    let _guard = OP_QUEUES
[2302](#2302)        .get_or_create(&path.to_path_buf())
[2303](#2303)        .acquire(ops::OpKind::Read, "share".to_string());
[2304](#2304)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[2305](#2305)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[2306](#2306)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[2307](#2307)    }
[2308](#2308)
[2309](#2309)    let config = load_config(&shard_dir)?;
[2310](#2310)    let repo_id = config.get("repo_id").cloned().unwrap_or_default();
[2311](#2311)    let repo_name = config.get("repo_name").cloned().unwrap_or_default();
[2312](#2312)
[2313](#2313)    let mut node = shard_net::p2p::Node::new().await?;
[2314](#2314)
[2315](#2315)    let ann_topic = shard_net::libp2p::gossipsub::IdentTopic::new("shard:ann");
[2317](#2317)    let repo_topic =
[2318](#2318)        shard_net::libp2p::gossipsub::IdentTopic::new(format!("/shard/repo/{}", repo_id));
[2319](#2319)    node.subscribe(&ann_topic)?;
[2320](#2320)    node.subscribe(&repo_topic)?;
[2321](#2321)
[2322](#2322)    let peers = load_peers(&shard_dir)?;
[2324](#2324)    for peer in peers {
[2325](#2325)        if let Ok(addr) = peer.parse::<shard_net::libp2p::Multiaddr>() {
[2326](#2326)            if let Err(e) = node.swarm.dial(addr.clone()) {
[2327](#2327)                tracing::warn!("Failed to dial peer {}: {}", addr, e);
[2328](#2328)            }
[2329](#2329)        }
[2330](#2330)    }
[2331](#2331)
[2332](#2332)    node.swarm.behaviour_mut().kademlia.bootstrap().ok();
[2334](#2334)
[2335](#2335)    node.listen(listen_addr).await?;
[2336](#2336)    let listen_addrs: Vec<String> = node.swarm.listeners().map(|a| a.to_string()).collect();
[2337](#2337)    if listen_addrs.is_empty() {
[2338](#2338)        tracing::warn!("No external listen addresses available — peers may not be able to connect");
[2339](#2339)    }
[2340](#2340)    let peer_multiaddr = listen_addrs.first().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
[2341](#2341)
[2342](#2342)    let store = Store::open(&shard_dir)?;
[2343](#2343)    let mut provider = RepoProvider {
[2344](#2344)        store,
[2345](#2345)        shard_dir: shard_dir.clone(),
[2346](#2346)    };
[2347](#2347)
[2348](#2348)    let publish_ann = |node: &mut shard_net::p2p::Node, ann: &shard_net::protocol::Announcement| {
[2350](#2350)        if let Ok(payload) = serde_json::to_vec(ann) {
[2351](#2351)            if let Err(e) = node.publish(&ann_topic, payload.clone()) {
[2352](#2352)                tracing::warn!("Failed to publish announcement: {}", e);
[2353](#2353)            }
[2354](#2354)            if let Err(e) = node.publish(&repo_topic, payload) {
[2355](#2355)                tracing::warn!("Failed to publish announcement: {}", e);
[2356](#2356)            }
[2357](#2357)        }
[2358](#2358)    };
[2359](#2359)
[2360](#2360)    if let Some(ref head) = branch::resolve_head(&shard_dir)?.1 {
[2362](#2362)        let (file_count, total_size) = commit_stats(&shard_dir, head).unwrap_or_default();
[2363](#2363)        let ann = shard_net::protocol::Announcement {
[2364](#2364)            commit_id: head.clone(),
[2365](#2365)            file_count,
[2366](#2366)            total_size,
[2367](#2367)            repo_name: repo_name.clone(),
[2368](#2368)            peer_multiaddr: format!("{}/p2p/{}", peer_multiaddr, node.local_peer_id()),
[2369](#2369)        };
[2370](#2370)        publish_ann(&mut node, &ann);
[2371](#2371)    }
[2372](#2372)

[2587](#2587)pub async fn relay(listen_addr: &str, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[2590](#2590)    let mut node = shard_net::p2p::Node::new().await?;

[2592](#2592)    if json {
[2593](#2593)        info!(
[2594](#2594)            "{}",
[2595](#2595)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
[2596](#2596)                "status": "relay active",
[2597](#2597)                "listen": listen_addr,
[2598](#2598)                "peer_id": node.local_peer_id().to_string(),
[2599](#2599)            }))?
[2600](#2600)        );
[2601](#2601)    } else {
[2602](#2602)        info!("Relay server active on {}", listen_addr);
[2603](#2603)        info!("Peer ID: {}", node.local_peer_id());
[2604](#2604)        info!("Ready to accept circuit relay v2 reservations");
[2605](#2605)    }

[2630](#2630)pub async fn sync(path: &Path, _json: bool) -> Result<()> {

[2682](#2682)        };

[2685](#2685)            info!("Announced commit {} on sync topic", head)

[2786](#2786)                            if !ann.peer_multiaddr.is_empty() && !address_book.contains_key(&peer) {
[2788](#2788)                                if let Ok(addr) = ann.peer_multiaddr.parse::<shard_net::libp2p::Multiaddr>() {
[2789](#2789)                                    address_book.entry(peer).or_default().push(addr);
[2790](#2790)                                }
[2791](#2791)                            }
[2792](#2792)                            let rate_key = (peer, commit_id_owned.clone());
[2794](#2794)                            if announce_counts.get(&rate_key).copied().unwrap_or(0) > 5 {
[2795](#2795)                                warn!("Rate limit exceeded for peer {} commit {}", peer, commit_id_owned);
[2796](#2796)                            } else {
[2797](#2797)                                *announce_counts.entry(rate_key).or_insert(0) += 1;
[2798](#2798)                                let our_head = branch::resolve_head(&shard_dir)?.1.unwrap_or_default();
[2800](#2800)                                if our_head != commit_id_owned {
[2801](#2801)                                    let (fc, ts) = commit_stats(&shard_dir, &our_head).unwrap_or_default();
[2802](#2802)                                    let reply = shard_net::protocol::Announcement {
[2803](#2803)                                        commit_id: our_head,
[2804](#2804)                                        file_count: fc,
[2805](#2805)                                        total_size: ts,
[2806](#2806)                                        repo_name: repo_name.clone(),
[2807](#2807)                                        peer_multiaddr: format!("{}/p2p/{}", peer_multiaddr, node.local_peer_id()),
[2808](#2808)                                    };
[2809](#2809)                                    publish_ann(&mut node, &reply);
[2810](#2810)                                }
[2811](#2811)                                if let Some(addrs) = address_book.get(&peer) {
[2812](#2812)                                    if let Some(addr) = addrs.first() {
[2813](#2813)                                        let multiaddr_str = format!("{}/p2p/{}", addr, peer);
[2814](#2814)                                        let path_clone = path_buf.clone();
[2815](#2815)                                        tokio::spawn(async move {
[2816](#2816)                                            match pull(&path_clone, &multiaddr_str, &commit_id_owned, false).await {
[2817](#2817)                                                Ok(_) => info!("Auto-pulled commit {} from {}", commit_id_owned, peer),
[2818](#2818)                                                Err(e) => error!("Auto-pull failed for commit {} from {}: {}", commit_id_owned, peer, e),
[2819](#2819)                                            }
[2820](#2820)                                        });
[2821](#2821)                                    }
[2822](#2822)                                }
[2823](#2823)                            }
[2824](#2824)                        }
[2825](#2825)                    }
[2826](#2826)                    shard_net::libp2p::swarm::SwarmEvent::Behaviour(
[2827](#2827)                        shard_net::p2p::ShardBehaviourEvent::RequestResponse(
[2828](#2828)                            shard_net::libp2p::request_response::Event::Message { peer, message },
[2829](#2829)                        ),
[2830](#2830)                    ) => {
[2831](#2831)                        if let shard_net::libp2p::request_response::Message::Request {
[2832](#2832)                            request, channel, ..
[2833](#2833)                        } = message
[2834](#2834)                        {
[2835](#2835)                            let req_count = request_counts.entry(peer).or_insert(0u32);
[2837](#2837)                            *req_count += 1;
[2838](#2838)                            if *req_count > rate_limit_max {
[2839](#2839)                                warn!("Dropping request from {}: rate limit exceeded", peer);
[2840](#2840)                                } else {
[2842](#2842)                                info!("Received request from {}", peer);
[2843](#2843)                                node.serve_request(&peer, &mut provider, request, channel);
[2844](#2844)                            }
[2845](#2845)                        } else {
[2846](#2846)                            info!("Received Response from {}", peer);
[2847](#2847)                        }
[2848](#2848)                    }
[2849](#2849)                    shard_net::libp2p::swarm::SwarmEvent::Behaviour(
[2850](#2850)                        shard_net::p2p::ShardBehaviourEvent::RequestResponse(
[2851](#2851)                            shard_net::libp2p::request_response::Event::OutboundFailure {
[2852](#2852)                                peer, error, ..
[2853](#2853)                            },
[2854](#2854)                        ),
[2855](#2855)                    ) => {
[2856](#2856)                        error!("Outbound failure to {}: {:?}", peer, error);
[2857](#2857)                    }
[2858](#2858)                    shard_net::libp2p::swarm::SwarmEvent::Behaviour(
[2859](#2859)                        shard_net::p2p::ShardBehaviourEvent::RequestResponse(
[2860](#2860)                            shard_net::libp2p::request_response::Event::InboundFailure {
[2861](#2861)                                peer, error, ..
[2862](#2862)                            },
[2863](#2863)                        ),
[2864](#2864)                    ) => {
[2865](#2865)                        error!("Inbound failure from {}: {:?}", peer, error);
[2866](#2866)                    }
[2867](#2867)                    shard_net::libp2p::swarm::SwarmEvent::Behaviour(

[2870](#2870)                        ),

[2873](#2873)                        for addr in info.listen_addrs {
[2874](#2874)                            address_book.entry(peer_id).or_default().push(addr);
[2875](#2875)                        }
[2876](#2876)                        let _ = std::io::stdout().flush();
[2877](#2877)                    }
[2878](#2878)                    shard_net::libp2p::swarm::SwarmEvent::Behaviour(

[2880](#2880)                    ) => {

[2882](#2882)                    }
[2883](#2883)                    shard_net::libp2p::swarm::SwarmEvent::ConnectionEstablished { peer_id, endpoint, .. } => {
[2884](#2884)                        info!("Connection established with {}", peer_id);
[2885](#2885)                        if let shard_net::libp2p::core::ConnectedPoint::Dialer { address, .. } = &endpoint {
[2888](#2888)                            address_book.entry(peer_id).or_default().push(address.clone());
[2889](#2889)                        }
[2890](#2890)                        node.swarm
[2891](#2891)                            .behaviour_mut()
[2892](#2892)                            .gossipsub

[2894](#2894)                        if let Some(ref head) = branch::resolve_head(&shard_dir)?.1 {
[2896](#2896)                            let (fc, ts) = commit_stats(&shard_dir, head).unwrap_or_default();

[2903](#2903)                            };
[2904](#2904)                            publish_ann(&mut node, &ann);
[2905](#2905)                        }
[2906](#2906)                    }
[2907](#2907)                    shard_net::libp2p::swarm::SwarmEvent::Behaviour(

[2940](#2940)
[2941](#2941)pub async fn pull(path: &Path, peer: &str, commit_id: &str, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[2942](#2942)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[2943](#2943)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[2946](#2946)        init(path, "flat", "zstd", "fixed", None, false, false)?;
[2947](#2947)    }
[2948](#2948)
[2949](#2949)    let store = Store::open(&shard_dir)?;
[2950](#2950)    let cipher = maybe_load_cipher(&shard_dir)?;
[2951](#2951)
[2952](#2952)    let mut node = shard_net::p2p::Node::new().await?;
[2953](#2953)    let _ = node.listen("/ip4/0.0.0.0/tcp/0").await;
[2954](#2954)
[2955](#2955)    let multiaddr: shard_net::libp2p::Multiaddr = peer.parse()?;
[2957](#2957)    let peer_id = match multiaddr.iter().last() {
[2958](#2958)        Some(shard_net::libp2p::multiaddr::Protocol::P2p(peer_id)) => peer_id,
[2959](#2959)        _ => anyhow::bail!("Multiaddr must end with /p2p/<peer_id>"),
[2960](#2960)    };
[2961](#2961)
[2962](#2962)    let keypair = load_keypair(&shard_dir)?;
[2964](#2964)    let public_key = keypair.verifying_key.to_bytes().to_vec();

[2966](#2966)        .await?;
[2967](#2967)

[2970](#2970)        info!("Pulling commit {} from {}...", commit_id, peer);
[2971](#2971)    }
[2972](#2972)    let commit_data = node
[2973](#2973)        .request_manifest(&multiaddr, peer_id, commit_id.to_string())
[2974](#2974)        .await?;
[2975](#2975)    let hash = blake3::hash(&commit_data);
[2976](#2976)    if hash.to_hex().to_string() != commit_id {
[2977](#2977)        anyhow::bail!("Commit hash mismatch");
[2978](#2978)    }
[2979](#2979)    let chunk = crate::chunker::Chunk {
[2980](#2980)        hash,
[2981](#2981)        data: commit_data.clone(),
[2982](#2982)        offset: 0,
[2983](#2983)    };
[2984](#2984)    store.put_chunk(&chunk)?;
[2985](#2985)
[2986](#2986)    let commit: Commit = metadata::deserialize(&commit_data)?;
[2987](#2987)    if !json {
[2988](#2988)        info!("Got commit: {}", commit.message);
[2989](#2989)    }
[2990](#2990)
[2991](#2991)    let keys_dir = shard_dir.join("keys");
[2993](#2993)    if let Some(kid) = &commit.key_id {
[2994](#2994)        if keys_dir.join("records").exists() {
[2995](#2995)            if let Ok(chain) = keychain::collect_rotation_chain(&keys_dir, kid) {
[2996](#2996)                let missing_rotations: Vec<&KeyRotation> = chain
[2997](#2997)                    .iter()
[2998](#2998)                    .filter(|r| store.get_chunk(&r.rotation_id).is_err())
[2999](#2999)                    .collect();
[3000](#3000)                if !missing_rotations.is_empty() {
[3001](#3001)                    if !json {
[3002](#3002)                        info!(
[3003](#3003)                            "Fetching {} key rotation records from peer...",
[3004](#3004)                            missing_rotations.len()
[3005](#3005)                        );
[3006](#3006)                    }
[3007](#3007)                    let rot_requests: Vec<(String, shard_net::protocol::ShardRequest)> =
[3008](#3008)                        missing_rotations
[3009](#3009)                            .iter()
[3010](#3010)                            .map(|r| {
[3011](#3011)                                (
[3012](#3012)                                    r.rotation_id.clone(),
[3013](#3013)                                    shard_net::protocol::ShardRequest::GetChunk(
[3014](#3014)                                        r.rotation_id.clone(),
[3015](#3015)                                    ),
[3016](#3016)                                )
[3017](#3017)                            })
[3018](#3018)                            .collect();
[3019](#3019)                    if let Ok(rot_results) = node
[3020](#3020)                        .request_parallel(&multiaddr, peer_id, rot_requests)
[3021](#3021)                        .await
[3022](#3022)                    {
[3023](#3023)                        for (rot_id, rot_data) in &rot_results {
[3024](#3024)                            let rh = blake3::hash(rot_data);
[3025](#3025)                            if rh.to_hex().to_string() != *rot_id {
[3026](#3026)                                info!("Key rotation record hash mismatch (expected {}, got {}) — skipping", rot_id, rh.to_hex());
[3027](#3027)                                continue;
[3028](#3028)                            }
[3029](#3029)                            store.put_chunk(&crate::chunker::Chunk {
[3030](#3030)                                hash: rh,
[3031](#3031)                                data: rot_data.clone(),
[3032](#3032)                                offset: 0,
[3033](#3033)                            })?;
[3034](#3034)                        }
[3035](#3035)                        if !json {
[3036](#3036)                            info!("Key rotation records synced from peer.");
[3037](#3037)                        }
[3038](#3038)                    }
[3039](#3039)                }
[3040](#3040)            }
[3041](#3041)        }
[3042](#3042)    }
[3043](#3043)
[3044](#3044)    if let Some(pk_hex) = &commit.public_key {
[3046](#3046)        let pk_bytes = hex::decode(pk_hex)?;
[3047](#3047)        let repo_id = blake3::hash(&pk_bytes).to_hex().to_string();
[3048](#3048)        let mut config = load_config(&shard_dir)?;
[3049](#3049)        config.insert("repo_id".to_string(), repo_id);
[3050](#3050)        save_config(&shard_dir, &config)?;
[3051](#3051)    }
[3052](#3052)
[3053](#3053)    let manifest_requests: Vec<(String, shard_net::protocol::ShardRequest)> = commit
[3055](#3055)        .manifests
[3056](#3056)        .iter()
[3057](#3057)        .map(|id| {
[3058](#3058)            (
[3059](#3059)                id.clone(),
[3060](#3060)                shard_net::protocol::ShardRequest::GetManifest(id.clone()),
[3061](#3061)            )
[3062](#3062)        })
[3063](#3063)        .collect();
[3064](#3064)    let manifest_results = node
[3065](#3065)        .request_parallel(&multiaddr, peer_id, manifest_requests)
[3066](#3066)        .await?;
[3067](#3067)
[3068](#3068)    let mut all_chunk_ids: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
[3069](#3069)    let mut file_manifests: Vec<FileManifest> = Vec::new();
[3070](#3070)    let mut chunk_compression: HashMap<String, String> = HashMap::new();
[3072](#3072)
[3073](#3073)    for (manifest_id, manifest_data) in &manifest_results {
[3074](#3074)        let hash = blake3::hash(manifest_data);
[3075](#3075)        if hash.to_hex().to_string() != *manifest_id {
[3076](#3076)            anyhow::bail!("Manifest hash mismatch: {}", manifest_id);
[3077](#3077)        }
[3078](#3078)        let chunk = crate::chunker::Chunk {
[3079](#3079)            hash,
[3080](#3080)            data: manifest_data.clone(),
[3081](#3081)            offset: 0,
[3082](#3082)        };
[3083](#3083)        store.put_chunk(&chunk)?;
[3084](#3084)        let manifest: FileManifest = metadata::deserialize(manifest_data)?;
[3085](#3085)        if !json {
[3086](#3086)            info!(
[3087](#3087)                "Fetching file: {} (compression: {})",
[3088](#3088)                manifest.name, manifest.compression
[3089](#3089)            );
[3090](#3090)        }
[3091](#3091)        for cid in &manifest.chunks {
[3092](#3092)            chunk_compression.insert(cid.clone(), manifest.compression.clone());
[3093](#3093)        }
[3094](#3094)        all_chunk_ids.extend(manifest.chunks.clone());
[3095](#3095)        file_manifests.push(manifest);
[3096](#3096)    }
[3097](#3097)
[3098](#3098)    let partial = partial::PartialTransfer::new(&shard_dir, commit_id)?;
[3100](#3100)    let partial_chunks = partial.list_chunks()?;
[3101](#3101)    let mut recovered = 0usize;
[3102](#3102)    for chunk_id in &partial_chunks {
[3103](#3103)        if let Ok(data) = partial.load_chunk(chunk_id) {
[3104](#3104)            let hash = blake3::hash(&data);
[3105](#3105)            if hash.to_hex().to_string() == *chunk_id {
[3106](#3106)                let chunk = crate::chunker::Chunk {
[3108](#3108)                    hash,
[3109](#3109)                    data: data.clone(),
[3110](#3110)                    offset: 0,
[3111](#3111)                };
[3112](#3112)                if store.put_chunk(&chunk).is_ok() {
[3113](#3113)                    recovered += 1;
[3114](#3114)                }
[3115](#3115)            } else {
[3116](#3116)                let _ = partial.remove_chunk(chunk_id);
[3118](#3118)            }
[3119](#3119)        }
[3120](#3120)    }
[3121](#3121)    if recovered > 0 {
[3122](#3122)        info!("Recovered {} chunks from partial transfer", recovered);
[3123](#3123)    }
[3124](#3124)
[3125](#3125)    let needed_chunks: Vec<String> = all_chunk_ids
[3127](#3127)        .into_iter()
[3128](#3128)        .filter(|id| store.get_chunk(id).is_err())
[3129](#3129)        .collect();
[3130](#3130)
[3131](#3131)    if !needed_chunks.is_empty() {
[3132](#3132)        if !json {
[3133](#3133)            info!("Fetching {} chunks...", needed_chunks.len());
[3134](#3134)        }
[3135](#3135)        let chunk_requests: Vec<(String, shard_net::protocol::ShardRequest)> = needed_chunks
[3136](#3136)            .iter()
[3137](#3137)            .map(|id| {
[3138](#3138)                (
[3139](#3139)                    id.clone(),
[3140](#3140)                    shard_net::protocol::ShardRequest::GetChunk(id.clone()),
[3141](#3141)                )
[3142](#3142)            })
[3143](#3143)            .collect();
[3144](#3144)        let chunk_results = node
[3145](#3145)            .request_parallel(&multiaddr, peer_id, chunk_requests)
[3146](#3146)            .await?;
[3147](#3147)        for (chunk_id, chunk_data) in &chunk_results {
[3148](#3148)            let compression: Compression = chunk_compression
[3150](#3150)                .get(chunk_id)
[3151](#3151)                .map(|s| s.as_str())
[3152](#3152)                .unwrap_or("none")
[3153](#3153)                .parse()?;
[3154](#3154)            let decrypted = match &cipher {
[3156](#3156)                Some(c) => c.decrypt(chunk_data)?,
[3157](#3157)                None => chunk_data.clone(),
[3158](#3158)            };
[3159](#3159)            let decompressed = compression.decompress(&decrypted)?;
[3160](#3160)            let hash = blake3::hash(&decompressed);
[3161](#3161)            if hash.to_hex().to_string() != *chunk_id {
[3162](#3162)                anyhow::bail!("Chunk hash mismatch: {}", chunk_id);
[3163](#3163)            }
[3164](#3164)            let chunk = crate::chunker::Chunk {
[3166](#3166)                hash,
[3167](#3167)                data: chunk_data.clone(),
[3168](#3168)                offset: 0,
[3169](#3169)            };
[3170](#3170)            store.put_chunk(&chunk)?;
[3171](#3171)            partial.save_chunk(chunk_id, chunk_data)?;
[3173](#3173)        }
[3174](#3174)    }
[3175](#3175)
[3176](#3176)    for manifest in &file_manifests {
[3178](#3178)        let compression = manifest.compression.parse::<Compression>()?;
[3179](#3179)        let mut file_data = Vec::new();
[3180](#3180)        for chunk_id in &manifest.chunks {
[3181](#3181)            let stored = store.get_chunk(chunk_id)?;
[3182](#3182)            let decrypted = match &cipher {
[3183](#3183)                Some(c) => c.decrypt(&stored)?,
[3184](#3184)                None => stored,
[3185](#3185)            };
[3186](#3186)            let decompressed = compression.decompress(&decrypted)?;
[3187](#3187)            file_data.extend_from_slice(&decompressed);
[3188](#3188)        }
[3189](#3189)        fs::write(path.join(&manifest.name), file_data)?;
[3190](#3190)        if !json {
[3191](#3191)            info!(
[3192](#3192)                "Reconstructed file: {} ({} bytes)",
[3193](#3193)                manifest.name, manifest.size
[3194](#3194)            );
[3195](#3195)        }
[3196](#3196)    }
[3197](#3197)
[3198](#3198)    partial.cleanup()?;
[3200](#3200)
[3201](#3201)    if json {
[3202](#3202)        info!(
[3203](#3203)            "{}",
[3204](#3204)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
[3205](#3205)                "status": "pull complete",
[3206](#3206)                "commit_id": commit_id,
[3207](#3207)            }))?
[3208](#3208)        );
[3209](#3209)    } else {
[3210](#3210)        info!("Pull complete.");
[3211](#3211)    }
[3212](#3212)    Ok(())

[3215](#3215)pub fn transfer_list(path: &Path, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[3216](#3216)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[3217](#3217)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[3218](#3218)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[3219](#3219)    }
[3220](#3220)    let transfers = partial::list_incomplete_transfers(&shard_dir)?;
[3221](#3221)    if json {
[3222](#3222)        info!("{}", serde_json::to_string(&transfers)?);
[3223](#3223)    } else {
[3224](#3224)        if transfers.is_empty() {
[3225](#3225)            info!("No incomplete transfers.");
[3226](#3226)        } else {
[3227](#3227)            for t in &transfers {
[3228](#3228)                info!("Incomplete transfer: {}", t);
[3229](#3229)            }
[3230](#3230)        }
[3231](#3231)    }
[3232](#3232)    Ok(())
[3233](#3233)}
[3234](#3234)
[3235](#3235)pub fn transfer_remove(path: &Path, commit_id: &str) -> Result<()> {
[3236](#3236)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[3237](#3237)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[3238](#3238)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[3239](#3239)    }
[3240](#3240)    partial::remove_transfer(&shard_dir, commit_id)?;
[3241](#3241)    info!("Removed transfer tracking for {}", commit_id);
[3242](#3242)    Ok(())

[3245](#3245)pub async fn push(path: &Path, peer: &str, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[3246](#3246)    let _guard = OP_QUEUES
[3247](#3247)        .get_or_create(&path.to_path_buf())
[3248](#3248)        .acquire(ops::OpKind::Write, "push".to_string());
[3249](#3249)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[3250](#3250)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[3251](#3251)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[3252](#3252)    }
[3253](#3253)
[3254](#3254)    let (_, head_id) = branch::resolve_head(&shard_dir)?;
[3255](#3255)    let head_id = head_id.ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("No commits to push"))?;
[3256](#3256)
[3257](#3257)    let store = Store::open(&shard_dir)?;
[3258](#3258)
[3259](#3259)    let mut objects: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> =
[3261](#3261)        std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
[3262](#3262)
[3263](#3263)    let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
[3265](#3265)    let mut stack = vec![head_id.clone()];
[3266](#3266)    while let Some(cid) = stack.pop() {
[3267](#3267)        if !seen.insert(cid.clone()) {
[3268](#3268)            continue;
[3269](#3269)        }
[3270](#3270)        if let Ok(data) = store.get_chunk(&cid) {
[3271](#3271)            objects.insert(cid, data.clone());
[3272](#3272)            if let Ok(commit) = metadata::deserialize::<Commit>(&data) {
[3273](#3273)                if let Some(kid) = &commit.key_id {
[3275](#3275)                    let keys_dir = shard_dir.join("keys");
[3276](#3276)                    if let Ok(chain) = keychain::collect_rotation_chain(&keys_dir, kid) {
[3277](#3277)                        for rot in &chain {
[3278](#3278)                            let rj = serde_json::to_vec(rot)?;
[3279](#3279)                            let rh = blake3::hash(&rj);
[3280](#3280)                            if !store.has_chunk(rh.to_hex().as_ref()) {
[3281](#3281)                                store.put_chunk(&crate::chunker::Chunk {
[3282](#3282)                                    hash: rh,
[3283](#3283)                                    data: rj.clone(),
[3284](#3284)                                    offset: 0,
[3285](#3285)                                })?;
[3286](#3286)                            }
[3287](#3287)                            objects.insert(rot.rotation_id.clone(), rj);
[3288](#3288)                        }
[3289](#3289)                    }
[3290](#3290)                }
[3291](#3291)                for mid in &commit.manifests {
[3292](#3292)                    if let Ok(manifest_data) = store.get_chunk(mid) {
[3293](#3293)                        objects.insert(mid.clone(), manifest_data.clone());
[3294](#3294)                        if let Ok(manifest) = metadata::deserialize::<FileManifest>(&manifest_data)
[3295](#3295)                        {
[3296](#3296)                            for cid in &manifest.chunks {
[3297](#3297)                                if let Ok(chunk_data) = store.get_chunk(cid) {
[3298](#3298)                                    objects.insert(cid.clone(), chunk_data);
[3299](#3299)                                }
[3300](#3300)                            }
[3301](#3301)                        }
[3302](#3302)                    }
[3303](#3303)                }
[3304](#3304)                for parent in &commit.parents {
[3305](#3305)                    stack.push(parent.clone());
[3306](#3306)                }
[3307](#3307)            }
[3308](#3308)        }
[3309](#3309)    }
[3310](#3310)
[3311](#3311)    if !json {
[3312](#3312)        info!(
[3313](#3313)            "Pushing {} objects ({} bytes)...",
[3314](#3314)            objects.len(),
[3315](#3315)            objects.values().map(|v| v.len() as u64).sum::<u64>()
[3316](#3316)        );
[3317](#3317)    }
[3318](#3318)
[3319](#3319)    let mut node = shard_net::p2p::Node::new().await?;
[3321](#3321)    let _ = node.listen("/ip4/0.0.0.0/tcp/0").await;
[3322](#3322)    let multiaddr: shard_net::libp2p::Multiaddr = peer.parse()?;
[3323](#3323)    let peer_id = match multiaddr.iter().last() {
[3324](#3324)        Some(shard_net::libp2p::multiaddr::Protocol::P2p(peer_id)) => peer_id,
[3325](#3325)        _ => anyhow::bail!("Multiaddr must end with /p2p/<peer_id>"),
[3326](#3326)    };
[3327](#3327)
[3328](#3328)    let keypair = load_keypair(&shard_dir)?;
[3330](#3330)    let public_key = keypair.verifying_key.to_bytes().to_vec();
[3331](#3331)    node.request_authenticate(&multiaddr, peer_id, public_key, &keypair.signing_key)
[3332](#3332)        .await?;
[3333](#3333)
[3334](#3334)    for (id, data) in &objects {
[3335](#3335)        node.request_put_chunk(&multiaddr, peer_id, id.clone(), data.clone())
[3336](#3336)            .await?;
[3337](#3337)    }
[3338](#3338)
[3339](#3339)    if json {
[3340](#3340)        info!(
[3341](#3341)            "{}",
[3342](#3342)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
[3343](#3343)                "status": "push complete",
[3344](#3344)                "objects": objects.len(),
[3345](#3345)            }))?
[3346](#3346)        );
[3347](#3347)    } else {
[3348](#3348)        info!("Push complete ({} objects).", objects.len());
[3349](#3349)    }
[3350](#3350)    Ok(())
[3351](#3351)}

[3405](#3405)pub fn key_list(path: &Path, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[3407](#3407)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");

[3428](#3428)                " (active)"

[3431](#3431)            };

[3444](#3444)pub fn key_verify(path: &Path, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[3446](#3446)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[3447](#3447)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[3448](#3448)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[3449](#3449)    }
[3450](#3450)    let keys_dir = shard_dir.join("keys");
[3451](#3451)    let errors = keychain::verify_keychain(&keys_dir)?;
[3452](#3452)
[3453](#3453)    if json {
[3454](#3454)        info!(
[3455](#3455)            "{}",
[3456](#3456)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
[3457](#3457)                "verified": errors.is_empty(),
[3458](#3458)                "errors": errors,
[3459](#3459)            }))?
[3460](#3460)        );
[3461](#3461)    } else {
[3462](#3462)        if errors.is_empty() {
[3463](#3463)            info!("Keychain verification successful.");
[3464](#3464)        } else {
[3465](#3465)            for err in &errors {
[3466](#3466)                error!("Keychain error: {}", err);
[3467](#3467)            }
[3468](#3468)            anyhow::bail!("Keychain verification failed ({} errors).", errors.len());
[3469](#3469)        }
[3470](#3470)    }
[3471](#3471)    Ok(())

[3495](#3495)

[3498](#3498)    }
[3499](#3499)
[3500](#3500)    let status = cmd
[3501](#3501)        .status()
[3502](#3502)        .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("Failed to run huggingface-cli: {}", e))?;

[3509](#3509)            "{}",

[3511](#3511)                &serde_json::json!({"status": "hf_pushed", "dataset": dataset_id})
[3512](#3512)            )?
[3513](#3513)        );
[3514](#3514)    } else {
[3515](#3515)        tracing::info!("Successfully pushed to HuggingFace!");
[3516](#3516)    }

[3521](#3521)pub fn hf_pull(
[3522](#3522)    path: &std::path::Path,
[3523](#3523)    dataset_id: &str,
[3524](#3524)    token: Option<&str>,
[3525](#3525)    json: bool,
[3526](#3526)) -> Result<()> {
[3527](#3527)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");

[3529](#3529)        anyhow::bail!("repository already exists at this path");
[3530](#3530)    }
[3531](#3531)
[3532](#3532)    if !json {
[3533](#3533)        tracing::info!("Pulling .shard from HuggingFace dataset: {}", dataset_id);
[3534](#3534)    }
[3535](#3535)
[3536](#3536)    let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new("huggingface-cli");
[3537](#3537)    cmd.arg("download");
[3538](#3538)    cmd.arg(dataset_id);
[3539](#3539)    cmd.arg(".shard");
[3540](#3540)    cmd.arg("--local-dir").arg(path);
[3541](#3541)    cmd.arg("--repo-type").arg("dataset");
[3542](#3542)
[3543](#3543)    if let Some(t) = token {
[3544](#3544)        cmd.arg("--token").arg(t);
[3545](#3545)    }
[3546](#3546)
[3547](#3547)    let status = cmd
[3548](#3548)        .status()
[3549](#3549)        .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("Failed to run huggingface-cli: {}", e))?;
[3550](#3550)    if !status.success() {
[3551](#3551)        anyhow::bail!("huggingface-cli download failed with status: {}", status);
[3552](#3552)    }
[3553](#3553)
[3554](#3554)    if json {
[3555](#3555)        tracing::info!(
[3556](#3556)            "{}",
[3557](#3557)            serde_json::to_string(
[3558](#3558)                &serde_json::json!({"status": "hf_pulled", "dataset": dataset_id})
[3559](#3559)            )?
[3560](#3560)        );
[3561](#3561)    } else {
[3562](#3562)        tracing::info!("Successfully pulled from HuggingFace!");
[3563](#3563)    }
[3564](#3564)
[3565](#3565)    Ok(())
[3566](#3566)}

# shard_core::branch - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/shard-core/2.3.0/shard_core/branch/index.html

[Skip to main content](#main-content)# Module branch

[Source](../../src/shard_core/branch.rs.html#1-232) - [create_branch](fn.create_branch.html)
- Create a new branch pointing to the given commit.
- [delete_branch](fn.delete_branch.html)
- Delete a branch.
- [list_branches](fn.list_branches.html)
- List all branches. Returns (current_branch, all_branches).
- [resolve_head](fn.resolve_head.html)
- Resolve the current HEAD.
Returns `(branch_name, commit_id)`.
- [resolve_rev](fn.resolve_rev.html)
- Resolve a branch or commit string to a commit id.
If `name`matches a branch, returns its tip. Otherwise treats it as a commit id.
- [set_head_branch](fn.set_head_branch.html)
- Set HEAD to point to a branch (`ref: refs/heads/<branch>`).
- [set_head_commit](fn.set_head_commit.html)
- Set HEAD to a bare commit id (detached).
- [update_branch_ref](fn.update_branch_ref.html)
- Update a branch ref to point to a commit.

- [BranchEntry](type.BranchEntry.html)
- A branch entry: (name, tip_commit_id).

# shard_core::chunker - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/shard-core/2.3.0/shard_core/chunker/index.html

## Structs[§](https://docs.rs#structs)

- [Chunk](https://docs.rs/struct.Chunk.html)
- A chunk produced by the chunker: Blake3 content hash, raw bytes, and byte offset in the original file.
- [Fixed](https://docs.rs/struct.FixedChunker.html)- Chunker
- Chunker that emits chunks of a fixed byte size.
Panics if `chunk_size`is zero.
- [Rabin](https://docs.rs/struct.RabinChunker.html)- Chunker

## Enums[§](https://docs.rs#enums)

- [Chunker](https://docs.rs/enum.Chunker.html)
- Unified chunker interface — dispatches to either `FixedChunker``RabinChunker`
- [Chunker](https://docs.rs/enum.ChunkerMode.html)- Mode
- Chunker mode selected at init time — either fixed-size or content-defined (Rabin).
Deserialized from `.shard/config.json`.

## Functions[§](https://docs.rs#functions)

- [validate_](https://docs.rs/fn.validate_chunk_size.html)- chunk_ - size
- Validate that a chunk size is within the acceptable range (1 to 16 MiB inclusive).

# shard_core::keychain - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/shard-core/2.3.0/shard_core/keychain/index.html

Walk the key rotation chain for a given key_id, returning all rotation
records in order (newest first). Starts from the rotation whose new_key_id
matches key_id, then follows previous_key_id backward to genesis.

Verify that key_id was an active (non-expired) key at the given
Unix timestamp (seconds). Keychain timestamps are stored in
milliseconds, so we compare at second precision.

---

# shard_core::wal - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/shard-core/2.3.0/shard_core/wal/index.html

## Structs[§](https://docs.rs#structs)

## Enums[§](https://docs.rs#enums)

## Functions[§](https://docs.rs#functions)

- [recover](https://docs.rs/fn.recover.html)
- Recover from a crash by inspecting the WAL.
If a CommitBegin was written without CommitEnd, restore HEAD and index.
If an AddBegin was written without AddEnd, just clear the WAL (orphaned
chunks will be cleaned up by `prune`).

# futures - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/futures/^0.3/

## Expand description

Abstractions for asynchronous programming.

This crate provides a number of core abstractions for writing asynchronous code:

- [Futures](https://docs.rs/future/index.html)are single eventual values produced by asynchronous computations. Some programming languages (e.g. JavaScript) call this concept “promise”.
- [Streams](https://docs.rs/stream/index.html)represent a series of values produced asynchronously.
- [Sinks](https://docs.rs/sink/index.html)provide support for asynchronous writing of data.
- [Executors](https://docs.rs/executor/index.html)are responsible for running asynchronous tasks.

The crate also contains abstractions for [asynchronous I/O](https://docs.rs/io/index.html) and
[cross-task communication](https://docs.rs/channel/index.html).

Underlying all of this is the *task system*, which is a form of lightweight
threading. Large asynchronous computations are built up using futures,
streams and sinks, and then spawned as independent tasks that are run to
completion, but *do not block* the thread running them.

The following example describes how the task system context is built and used within macros and keywords such as async and await!.

```
fn main() {
    let pool = ThreadPool::new().expect("Failed to build pool");
    let (tx, rx) = mpsc::unbounded::<i32>();
    // Create a future by an async block, where async is responsible for an
    // implementation of Future. At this point no executor has been provided
    // to this future, so it will not be running.
    let fut_values = async {
        // Create another async block, again where the Future implementation
        // is generated by async. Since this is inside of a parent async block,
        // it will be provided with the executor of the parent block when the parent
        // block is executed.
        //
        // This executor chaining is done by Future::poll whose second argument
        // is a std::task::Context. This represents our executor, and the Future
        // implemented by this async block can be polled using the parent async
        // block's executor.
        let fut_tx_result = async move {
            (0..100).for_each(|v| {
                tx.unbounded_send(v).expect("Failed to send");
            })
        };
        // Use the provided thread pool to spawn the generated future
        // responsible for transmission
        pool.spawn_ok(fut_tx_result);
        let fut_values = rx
            .map(|v| v * 2)
            .collect();
        // Use the executor provided to this async block to wait for the
        // future to complete.
        fut_values.await
    };
    // Actually execute the above future, which will invoke Future::poll and
    // subsequently chain appropriate Future::poll and methods needing executors
    // to drive all futures. Eventually fut_values will be driven to completion.
    let values: Vec<i32> = executor::block_on(fut_values);
    println!("Values={:?}", values);
}
```
The majority of examples and code snippets in this crate assume that they are inside an async block as written above.

## Macros[§](https://docs.rs#macros)

- [join](https://docs.rs/macro.join.html)- `async-await`
- Polls multiple futures simultaneously, returning a tuple of all results once complete.
- [pending](https://docs.rs/macro.pending.html)- `async-await`
- A macro which yields to the event loop once.
- [pin_mut](https://docs.rs/macro.pin_mut.html)
- Pins a value on the stack.
- [poll](https://docs.rs/macro.poll.html)- `async-await`
- A macro which returns the result of polling a future once within the
current `async`context.
- [ready](https://docs.rs/macro.ready.html)
- Extracts the successful type of `Poll<T>`.
- [select](https://docs.rs/macro.select.html)- `async-await`and- `std`
- Polls multiple futures and streams simultaneously, executing the branch
for the future that finishes first. If multiple futures are ready,
one will be pseudo-randomly selected at runtime. Futures directly
passed to `select!`must be`Unpin`and implement`FusedFuture`.
- [select_](https://docs.rs/macro.select_biased.html)- biased - `async-await`
- Polls multiple futures and streams simultaneously, executing the branch
for the future that finishes first. Unlike `select!``select_biased!`must be`Unpin`and implement`FusedFuture`.
- [stream_](https://docs.rs/macro.stream_select.html)- select - `async-await`and- `std`
- Combines several streams, all producing the same `Item`type, into one stream. This is similar to`select_all`but does not require the streams to all be the same type. It also keeps the streams inline, and does not require`Box<dyn Stream>`s to be allocated. Streams passed to this macro must be`Unpin`.
- [try_](https://docs.rs/macro.try_join.html)- join - `async-await`
- Polls multiple futures simultaneously, resolving to a `Result`

# libp2p - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/libp2p/^0.53/

## Expand description

libp2p is a modular peer-to-peer networking framework.

To learn more about the general libp2p multi-language framework visit [https://libp2p.io](https://libp2p.io).

To get started with this libp2p implementation in Rust, please take a look
at the [ tutorials](https://docs.rs/tutorials/index.html). Further examples can be found in the

[examples](https://github.com/libp2p/rust-libp2p/tree/master/examples)directory.

- A libp2p module for managing allow and blocks lists to peers.
- Transports, upgrades, multiplexing and node handling of*libp2p*.
- Bare-minimum multihash data structure.
- This module implements the`/ipfs/ping/1.0.0`protocol.
- Generic request/response protocols.
- High-level network manager.
- TLS configuration based on libp2p TLS specs.
- Rust-libp2p Tutorials to get started with.
- Implementation of the libp2p`Transport`trait for Unix domain sockets.
- Implementation of UPnP port mapping for libp2p.
- Implementation of the libp2p`Transport`trait for Websockets.

- Easy way for a user to create a`Multiaddr`.

- Representation of a Multiaddr.
- Identifier of a peer of the network.
- Identifies a protocol for a stream.
- Contains the state of the network, plus the way it should behave.

- Possible upgrade on an inbound connection or substream.
- Possible upgrade on an outbound connection or substream.
- A transport provides connection-oriented communication between two peers through ordered streams of data (i.e. connections).
- Trait automatically implemented on all objects that implement`Transport`. Provides some additional utilities.

# yoagent-state 0.3.0 - Docs.rs

Source: https://docs.rs/crate/yoagent-state/0.3.0

# yoagent-state

Durable memory and lineage for long-running agents.

Agents do not just need logs. They need to remember what failed, what changed, what tested it, who approved it, and why the current project state exists.

`yoagent-state` is an ActiveGraph-inspired Rust continuity runtime for agent systems. It records append-only events, replays them into a semantic graph, and gives you primitives for goals, tasks, observations, hypotheses, patches, artifacts, evals, decisions, policies, behaviors, replay, and forks.

It helps answer the questions that matter after an agent run:

- What goal was the agent trying to satisfy?
- What task, run, or observation produced this state?
- Why does this patch exist?
- What failure did it address?
- What eval validated it?
- What files or artifacts did it reference?
- Was it approved, rejected, or promoted?

```
goal -> task -> run -> observation -> failure -> hypothesis -> patch -> artifact -> eval -> decision -> promotion
```
That line is the common causal spine, not a required linear workflow. A diff is an artifact. Promotion is a patch status transition backed by evals and decisions.

```
flowchart LR
  goal["goal"]
  task["task"]
  run["run"]
  observation["observation"]
  failure["failure"]
  hypothesis["hypothesis"]
  patch["patch"]
  artifact["artifact"]
  eval["eval"]
  decision["decision"]
  promoted["promoted status"]
  task -- serves --> goal
  run -- produces --> observation
  observation -- observes --> failure
  hypothesis -- explains --> failure
  patch -- addresses --> failure
  patch -- advances --> goal
  patch -- references --> artifact
  patch -- validated_by --> eval
  patch -- approved_by --> decision
  decision -- allows --> promoted
```
```
yoagent executes.
yoagent-state remembers.
yoyo evolve improves.
```
## Start in 60 seconds

Add the crate:

```
```
Run the demo from a local clone:

```
```
You should see a lineage report like this:

```
# Make retry behavior reliable
- id: goal_retry_reliability
- kind: goal
- status: InProgress
## Incoming
- serves <- task_retry_timeout
- blocks <- failure_retry_timeout
- advances <- patch_retry_state
```
This means the goal is being served by a task, blocked by a failure, and advanced by a patch.

```
flowchart LR
  task["task_retry_timeout<br/>kind: task"]
  failure["failure_retry_timeout<br/>kind: failure"]
  patch["patch_retry_state<br/>kind: patch"]
  goal["goal_retry_reliability<br/>kind: goal<br/>status: InProgress"]
  task -- serves --> goal
  failure -- blocks --> goal
  patch -- advances --> goal
```
To see the patch/eval/decision lane:

```
```
Run the full test suite:

```
```
Try local JSONL persistence:

```
YOAGENT_STATE_EVENTS=.yoyo/state/events.jsonl
```
## What it does

`yoagent-state` gives long-running agents durable continuity without taking over your project.

- Records append-only events for goals, tasks, runs, observations, model calls, tool calls, failures, hypotheses, patches, evals, decisions, and artifacts.
- Replays events into a small semantic graph projection.
- Tracks goal/task lineage and patch lifecycle from proposal to approval, rejection, or promotion.
- References real project artifacts such as diffs, commits, logs, eval output, and files.
- Supports typed packs, policy gates, behavior subscriptions, replay, fork, and diff primitives.
- Exposes lineage queries so agents and humans can explain why state exists.

Git still owns concrete project changes. `yoagent-state` stores why those changes happened, what tested them, and what they mean.

## When you need this

Use `yoagent-state` when:

- your agent runs longer than one prompt
- you need to explain why a code change exists
- you want eval and decision history attached to patches
- you want durable state without adopting a workflow engine or graph database
- you are building on `yoagent`,`yoyo evolve`, or another Rust agent loop

You probably do not need it for one-off scripts, stateless chat flows, or projects where Git commit messages already capture enough context.

## Minimal Rust example

```
use json;
use ;
async
```
## What it is not

`yoagent-state` is intentionally small.

- not a replacement for Git
- not a workflow engine
- not a graph database
- not a full project database
- not a universal agent framework
- not a hidden self-modification system

The motto is simple but effective.

## Acknowledgments

The core idea for `yoagent-state` comes from [Yohei Nakajima](https://github.com/yoheinakajima) and his [ActiveGraph](https://github.com/yoheinakajima/activegraph) work. This project is an independent Rust implementation inspired by that idea, with a Rust-first architecture for `yoagent` and `yoyo evolve`. See [ACKNOWLEDGMENTS.md](https://docs.rs/ACKNOWLEDGMENTS.md).

## License

Licensed under the [MIT license](https://docs.rs/LICENSE).
